card.name: Opioid overdose and respiratory warning phrases
card.fires_on: Mainly the word "muscle" in "skeletal muscle flaccidity" in opioid overdose descriptions. It also fires on a few other words partway through set phrases, such as "Mark|ed" and "signs" before sedation.

modes.label: Skeletal muscle in overdose
modes.description: The word muscle after "skeletal" in the list of overdose signs for opioid labels.
modes.example: somnolence progressing to stupor or coma, skeletal<< muscle>> flaccidity, cold and clammy

modes.label: Partway through set phrases
modes.description: A word inside a fixed label phrase or term, where the next word is highly predictable.
modes.example: atypical snoring, and death. Mark<<ed>> mydriasis rather than miosis

modes.label: Odd citation fragments
modes.description: A letter inside a DOI string in a reference.
